requirements.text: What you'll do...Immigration sponsorship is not available for this role. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.
This is a full-time onsite role based in Sunnyvale, CA; remote and hybrid options are not available.
5+ years of experience in Full stack engineering, automation, or quality engineering.

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 2 years’ experience in software engineering or related area.
Strong experience with Java and Python, or similar languages.
Hands-on experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, distributed systems, and backend automation with RestAssured.
Experience with mobile/web automation frameworks (Appium, XCUI Test, Selenium, Playwright).
Strong working knowledge of SQL and No-SQL persistence approaches
Strong understanding of system integration, debugging, and performance optimization.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
Experience building or integrating GenAI-powered applications, agents, or workflows.
Experience designing automation frameworks for Native, Web, or Backend platforms. Experience with large-scale eCommerce, retail, or customer-facing systems.

Strong understanding of quality engineering principles, test strategy, and defect management.
